headline: Egypt Fintech MNT-Halan Gains 6.6% in Country's Biggest IPO Since 2021
summary: Shares of Egyptian fintech MNT-Halan rose 6.6% in their trading debut, valuing the company at around $770 million in Egypt's largest IPO since 2021.
why: MNT-Halan is a prominent North African fintech platform, providing microfinance and digital banking services in Egypt's unbanked market.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: A strong market debut for the country's largest IPO in years boosts confidence in Egypt's capital markets.
